description: This file defines the ThemeFactory class responsible for managing themes within the widget model of the OFBiz framework. It handles loading, caching, and retrieving visual themes and model themes from XML files and database data, as well as resolving themes based on user sessions and preferences.

classes.name: ThemeFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for loading and managing theme models and visual themes, including caching and resolving themes based on user context and configuration.

methods.name: readThemeDocument
methods.description: Creates a ModelTheme object from an XML Document representing a theme configuration.

methods.name: pullModelThemesFromXmlToCache
methods.description: Loads all theme XML files and populates the theme caches with ModelTheme and VisualTheme instances.

methods.name: checkForWidgetFolder
methods.description: Checks a directory path for subfolders containing widget themes and returns list of theme XML files.

methods.name: getThemeXmlFiles
methods.description: Scans the OFBiz themes and plugins directories for theme XML files.

methods.name: getVisualThemeFromId
methods.description: Retrieves a VisualTheme object from cache by ID, reloading cache if necessary.

methods.name: getModelThemeFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelTheme from a resource location URL, loading and caching it if not already cached.

methods.name: getAvailableThemes
methods.description: Returns a list of VisualThemes linked to a specific visualThemeSetId, combining cache and database data.

methods.name: resolveVisualTheme
methods.description: Resolves the enabled VisualTheme based on current user session, preferences, and default properties.
